verdict.rationale: An end-user consent or revocation portal is a fair question for a bank-data aggregation API like Teller, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a surface where end users view or revoke which apps hold access to their bank data. The Identity API's mention of accounts the end-user 'granted your application access authorization' is a developer-side data endpoint, not a user-facing consent management portal, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, end users can see and revoke what they've shared — a documented consent surface or portal where a user manages which apps hold access to their bank data
